Background

Khanna has represented a Silicon Valley district since 2017 and was a national co-chair of Bernie Sanders's 2020 campaign. He has built a profile on economic nationalism, Medicare for All and opposition to foreign wars.

Outlook

Khanna told reporters in Denver he is certainly considering a run and that the reception there made him more likely to, and he expects candidates to start entering next year. Allies launched a draft group, Run Ro, on November 5, and he says he will decide with his family after the holidays. Progressives are not unified behind him, and he competes for the same lane as Ocasio-Cortez.
